target_exact_object.name: PUBLISHED_bPHP_COLLISION_SKOLEM_ROUTE_COMPARISON
target_exact_object.primary_reference: Brendan Juba and Kuldeep S. Meel, The Limitations and Power of NP-Oracle Based Functional Synthesis Techniques, AAAI 2026, DOI 10.1609/aaai.v40i17.38440
target_exact_object.published_family: bounded pigeonhole / collision-witness relational specification used for the interpolation limitation
target_exact_object.intended_question: Can frozen V1.1 synthesize and certify compact witness functions on the published family without inheriting the documented resolution-interpolation bottleneck?

facts: The paper explicitly studies functional synthesis when small Skolem functions exist.
It proves an exponential-size limitation for resolution-based interpolation on a pigeonhole-based family.
It separately gives a sequential-synthesis trap family where early local choices can force exponentially large later functions with high probability.

explicit_polynomial_construction_checked.rule: Before any experiment, reconstruct the exact published relation and its compact Skolem functions, then test whether those functions already have an immediate V1.1 derivation. If yes, analytically discharge instead of scaling.

known_tractable_representation_checked.rule: Do not assume the published interpolation lower bound implies hardness for SAUNF/SynNNF/V1.1.

published_hard_family_available_checked.choice: Use the published family rather than inventing another synthetic random family.

lower_bound_model_match_checked.applies_to: resolution-based interpolation construction analyzed by Juba-Meel
lower_bound_model_match_checked.required_claim_form: V1.1 avoids / does not avoid a documented interpolation bottleneck on this family; never claim the interpolation lower bound as a V1.1 lower bound.

external_baseline_availability_checked.required_next_step: Determine whether the exact published bPHP family is already packaged in a public corpus or must be reconstructed faithfully from the paper before benchmarking.

novel_separator_statement: A PASS would distinguish frozen V1.1 from a published resolution-interpolation route on the same relation; a FAIL could localize whether V1.1 loses compactness in synthesis, representation, domain proof, or sharing. Neither outcome is implied by the published interpolation lower bound alone.

analytic_discharge_checked.blocker: Exact relation and compact published Skolem construction must be reconstructed first.

next_actions_only: Reconstruct the exact bPHP relation and parameterization from the primary paper.
Write the published compact Skolem functions explicitly.
Map those functions to V1.1 rule forms and obtain a symbolic size bound if possible.
Locate or faithfully build external-tool benchmark representation.
Only if a nontrivial route separator survives, create a frozen prereg/source family.
